response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, s.instownpct AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT mix, AVG(own) AS mbase FROM units GROUP BY mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS oavg FROM units), kept AS (SELECT u.own, u.own / b.mbase AS ratio, u.own - o.oavg AS excess FROM units u JOIN base b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE u.own > o.oavg) SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_own, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept
